description:
**Req ID:** 
 381972
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Z3\_Lead Scrum Master\|Scrum Master to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
   

  

**Job Summary:** 
 As a Scrum Master, you will facilitate and coordinate Agile Scrum processes within our organization, ensuring the company can work collaboratively and efficiently to deliver high\-quality solutions. You will work closely with the product development team to ensure that the work progresses on schedule, within budget, and to the desired level of quality. Additionally, you will serve as a coach and mentor to our team – helping to foster a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring that the team is meeting its objectives consistently.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily stand\-up meetings, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coach the development team in Agile and Scrum practices to ensure that they understand and embrace the methodology.
* Help the team remove obstacles to progress, while empowering them to take ownership of the process.
* Ensure the development team is following Scrum practices and helping them continuously improve their performance.
* Help prioritize and manage the product backlog to ensure that the team is always working on the most valuable items.
* Act as a liaison between the development team and stakeholders to ensure that everyone is aligned and informed about the progress of the project.
* Ensure that the team is delivering high\-quality software that meets customer requirements on time.
* Identify and troubleshoot obstacles that are hindering the team's progress.
* Promote continuous improvement through retrospectives and feedback sessions.
* Communicate project status, risks and issues to stakeholders.
* Track KPIs and help teams deliver high\-quality products/solutions on time.
* Ensure that the team follows the Scrum framework and adheres to Agile principles.
* Training, mentoring, and supporting scrum teams to follow agile values, principles, and practices.
* Determining and managing tasks, issues, risks, and action items.
* Planning and organizing demos and product/system testing.
* Ensuring the proper use of collaborative processes and removing impediments for the scrum team.
* Tracking project processes, deliverables, and financials.
* Preparing and presenting status reports to stakeholders.
* ART and PI Planning.


**Required Skills and Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Minimum of 7\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master.
* Strong knowledge of Agile Scrum principles and practices.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to lead and facilitate Scrum ceremonies.
* Exemplifies and promotes Agile values and principles.
* Outstanding communication, facilitation, negotiation, and coaching skills.
* Knowledge of an agile framework or method (i.e. Scrum, Kanban), or understanding of software development life cycle models as well as in\-depth knowledge of traditional project management principles and practices.
* Adept at refinement, story splitting, estimation, velocity, retrospection, and other Scrum techniques.


**Preferred Skills and Qualifications:**
* Certification in Agile methodologies, like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM).
* SAFe certification and Kanban certification are a plus.
* Coaching and PI planning experience is mandatory
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Prior knowledge of Agile project management tool such as Jira.


 Add On’s:
   

  

* Support to team for Testing, Support during Production issues etc. would be beneficial.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

 DIGIS Tribes develop and maintain applications for Business Lines Avionics Global Services AGS, inside Thales GBU AVS.
   

  

 AVS business lines provides, all around the world, customer support and maintenance of avionics Thales equipment.
   

  

 The applications are built on top and outside SAP ERP. Their main business goals are to facilitate users’ day\-to\-day works (logisticians, repair technicians, marketing, sales, …) and improve overall industrial performance.
   

  

 Such applications need to be connected in real time to SAP ERP, through OData web services, to read, update or delete data (SAP objects). We also have multiple reports and dashboards executed from SAP as wel.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to join our agile delivery team. The Scrum Master will be responsible for facilitating scrum ceremonies, coaching teams on agile best practices, removing impediments, and driving continuous improvement to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Review, Retrospective) effectively and efficiently.
* Act as a servant leader and coach to Agile teams, promoting agile values, principles, and practices.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners to manage and prioritize the product backlog.
* Remove impediments and blockers that hinder team progress.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging feedback, team collaboration, and learning.
* Track and report key agile metrics (e.g., velocity, burn\-down charts) to stakeholders.
* Support cross\-team collaboration and coordination in a scaled agile environment.
* Assist teams in delivering high\-quality software incrementally and iteratively.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and promote a positive and productive team dynamic.
* Engage with stakeholders at various levels to ensure transparency and alignment.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5 to 7 years of experience working as a Scrum Master or in an agile team environment.
* Strong knowledge of Agile frameworks and methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent agile certifications preferred.
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to remove blockers and resolve conflicts.
* Experience working with distributed and cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with agile project management tools such as Jira, Rally, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills, capable of engaging and influencing at all organizational levels


**Knowledge/ Skills**
* Experience in software development lifecycle (SDLC) and understanding of technical environments.
* Knowledge of scaled agile frameworks (SAFe, LeSS) and experience in large enterprise agile transformations.
* Ability to drive organizational change and agile adoption beyond the immediate team.


**Personal Attributes**
* Autonomous, curious, rigorous, with excellent analytical and summarizing skills.
* Good collaboration and communication skills
* You have a sense of service; you are comfortable communicating and you are diplomatic
* You have a sense of confidentiality, integrity and ethics


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Manager, Technical Professional Services
   

  

**About Your Role**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead the planning and delivery of complex technology initiatives that support business priorities, operational performance, and client outcomes. You will work across engineering, product, operations, risk, and business teams to align scope, timelines, dependencies, and execution. Your work helps teams deliver solutions with clear accountability, measurable progress, and consistent project outcomes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, including project planning, scope management, milestone tracking, dependency management, and issue resolution
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define project objectives, document requirements, establish success measures, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, status reporting, risk logs, decision logs, and communication plans for multiple concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to manage technical deliverables, release readiness, testing dependencies, and implementation activities
* Identify project risks, blockers, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation plans with clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths
* Facilitate project meetings, steering updates, and stakeholder reviews to communicate progress, decisions, and changes in scope, schedule, or priority
* Use project management tools and delivery frameworks to track execution, improve transparency, and support consistent project governance across teams
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You'll Need To Have**
* 8\+ years of experience in technical project management delivering software, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise technology initiatives across cross\-functional teams
* 8\+ years of experience building and maintaining project plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving project execution from initiation through implementation
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms for planning, tracking, and reporting
* Experience facilitating project governance, stakeholder communication, and status reporting with technical and business audiences
* Experience managing delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies in a technology environment
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience supporting payments, financial technology, banking, or regulated industry initiatives
* Experience coordinating software releases, system integrations, or enterprise change initiatives
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent project delivery certification
* Experience working with data reporting tools to measure project health, delivery trends, and operational outcomes


**How You'll Work**
* This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

**Job Description**
**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**
 At Electrolux Group, we’re embarking on a Digital Transformation journey, delivering world\-class Direct\-to\-Consumer (D2C) solutions through our Consumer Direct Interaction Organization (CDI XO). As part of a Delivery team embedded at a Digital Product Organization, we are looking for a skilled Release Manager to join our dynamic team, supporting our growth across Europe, APAC, and the Americas. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in ensuring the quality of our cutting\-edge solutions, all while working in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment across multiple Agile Release Trains.
   

  

 We operate in a fast\-paced environment where timing is critical. When a timeline is committed, it is essential that we deliver on time. Delays in delivery can have a direct impact on our company targets and overall success, so timely execution and adherence to schedules is a key component of our delivery initiatives.
   

  

 If you have a passion for delivering successful releases, a background in driving release planning and execution for large\-scale E\-Commerce/CRM/ERP/Cloud Native in\-house digital products, thriving in a fast\-paced digital transformation environment, we want you to be a part of our journey.
   

  

 Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
   

  

**All about the role:**
 Our mission as the Delivery team within CDI XO is to
 *"enable
 **smooth deliveries***
*of high\-quality digital products on
 **time and budget** 
 in CDI XO, providing
 **transparency** 
 to CAs and CDI stakeholders throughout the software delivery life\-cycle."*
 Therefore as a Release Manager within our Digital Product Organization, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring smooth, timely, uneventful releases across multiple Agile Release Trains in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.
   

  

 This position is a mix of:
   

  

* Hands\-on technical leader – requiring constant deep dives into systems, developing extensive knowledge of the technology architecture, and ensuring robust release processes.
* People leader – leading and mentoring a team of Release Engineers who manage technology\-specific releases, fostering collaboration and accountability across the delivery pipeline.


 Core Aspects of Release Management in Our Organization:
   

  

* Communication – Ensure transparency by generating clear release notes for any release exposing features to business or consumers.
* Calendar – Maintenance of a consolidated up\-to\-date release calendar, including freeze periods, enabling proper planning across all product teams.
* Execution – Orchestration of complex technical releases since planning until post go\-live validations, as well as dependency and resource management.
* Operational Efficiency – Continuous exploration of opportunities for automation with Engineering Org to reduce lead time of release execution.
* Governance – Establishment and enforcement of clear guidelines to enable smooth operations and uneventful releases.


**About the CDI Experience Organization:**
 The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end\-users and consumers across both pre\-purchase and post\-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15\+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E\-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI. You will play a key role in ensuring the right sizing, right skillset, and core competency across these product areas.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Perform deep and long\-term planning of a consolidated CDI XO Release calendar by aligning with all application owners expected release windows, blackout periods, taking into considerations business critical periods, such as Black Friday/Christmas.
* Own and manage the release planning, scheduling, and execution across digital product teams.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, Processes Owners, Tech Leads, Engineering Managers and Delivery Leads to ensure alignment on release timelines.
* Lead and mentor Release Engineers, providing guidance on best practices and career development.
* Identify and mitigate risks that could impact delivery schedules or product quality.
* Drive continuous improvement in release processes, ensuring efficiency and predictability.
* Act as the central point of contact for release communications, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned.
* Monitor release performance metrics and provide insights to leadership for decision\-making.
* Ensure compliance with organizational standards and governance for all releases.


**Who are you:**
* Proven experience (5\+ years) in Release Management, Delivery Management, or Project Management within digital product organizations.
* Solid experience in driving release planning and execution, preferably in a multiple technology domain such as E\-commerce/CRM/ERP rollouts.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in a SAFe environment.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability of making multiple tactical/operational decisions on a daily basis.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment where timely execution is critical.
* Experience working with global teams across multiple regions (Europe, APAC, Americas) is a plus.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and CI/CD pipelines is highly desirable.
* Sporadic need to cover business critical releases out of regular business hours.


**Where you'll be:**
 This is a full\-time position, based in Bangalore, India
   

  

**Benefits Highlights:**
* Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
* Discounts on our award\-winning Electrolux products and services
* Family\-friendly benefits
* Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

**Description**
 Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
   

  

 Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
   

  

 The
 **Senior Business Systems Analyst** 
 serves as a critical link between business stakeholders and technical teams.
 **This role is responsible for translating business needs into detailed, testable technical requirements for both user interface (UI) and API development work.**
 In addition to core business analysis responsibilities, this position performs hands\-on quality assurance activities, including test case creation, execution, defect documentation, and validation of system functionality. The ideal candidate is highly detail\-oriented, excels at clarifying ambiguity, and ensures that delivered solutions align precisely with documented requirements.
   

  

 This role operates in a collaborative Agile environment and partners closely with product owners, developers, and QA to ensure successful delivery of high\-quality software solutions.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document functional and non\-functional requirements
* Translate business needs into clear, structured user stories with detailed acceptance criteria
* Create clear and succinct technical requirements for:
+ User Interface (UI) components, workflows, validations, and user interactions
+ API functionality, including request/response structures, data mappings, business rules, and integration requirements

* Develop process flows, use cases, data mappings, and system documentation to support development efforts
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, and traceable through the development lifecycle
* Facilitate story grooming with engineers and QAs
* Review completed work to confirm alignment with documented requirements
* Collaborate with QA to develop test strategies, test plans, and detailed test cases based on documented requirements
* As needed, execute functional, integration, and regression testing
* Validate UI behavior, data flows, and API responses against defined specifications
* Perform data validation and basic query analysis using SQL to ensure accuracy and completeness
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT) by preparing test scenarios and assisting business users


**What You Will Bring**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst or in a hybrid BA/QA role
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications for both UI and API development
* Hands\-on experience writing and executing test cases
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, data flows, and system integrations
* Working knowledge of SQL and ability to validate and analyze data
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and requirements documentation tools
* Strong analytical, documentation, and organizational skills, with excellent attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**What Will Set You Apart**
* Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred
* Experience in financial services or other regulated environments
* Comfort working closely with developers while maintaining an independent validation perspective
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams
* A proactive approach to identifying requirement gaps and edge cases

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
Esper revolutionizes device management by redefining what it should be: a driver of business growth. With advanced and modern capabilities, automation replaces outdated workflows, re\-provisioning becomes obsolete, and managing by exception transforms efficiency, resulting in increased efficiency, improved ROI, and bolsters security for device fleets of all sizes. Esper has been recognized as number 735 on Inc. Magazine's 2025 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in America, and 133 on the 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500\. Some of the world’s most innovative brands, like Google, Doordash, Taco Bell, Clinical ink, SF 49ers, and Intelity, rely on Esper to deliver exceptional device experiences. Esper partners with the leading mobile device hardware manufacturers, solution providers, and distributors globally.
   

  

 We’re looking for a SDE III to join Esper, who will be part of a team building Esper’s flagship product, the Esper Foundation for Android, a custom Android\-based operating system built for enterprises, optimized for dedicated Android devices.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer working with the Esper Foundation team, you will play a crucial role in the development, customization, and enhancement of our Android\-based platforms. You will be responsible for designing and implementing software solutions, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and driving the technical direction of Foundation.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* xTS Testing: Lead the design, execution, and management of CTS, VTS, and GTS testing to ensure Android compatibility, security, and performance compliance across all Foundation platforms
* Issue Diagnosis \& Resolution: Investigate, analyze, and resolve test failures by collaborating with fellow engineers, ensuring quick resolution and minimal release delays
* Documentation \& Reporting: Maintain detailed documentation of test cases, execution results, and defect analysis to support continuous improvement and accountability
* Development and Customization: Outside of the primary charter of leading our testing and automation efforts, assist with development of the Esper Foundation for Android product at multiple levels of the stack
* Technical Ownership: Complete technical ownership on some of the Foundation components. Also, become the Subject Matter Expert(SME) for the team.


 What we are looking for
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience
* Experience: 2\-5 years of experience in software development or testing, with a strong focus on Android platform development, AOSP and Android test suites.
* Technical Skills:
* 
+ Strong software engineering fundamentals, including the use of version control systems like Git
+ Proficiency in Java or Kotlin for Android development.
+ Understanding of C/C\+\+ for low\-level programming and system integration.
+ Experience with Android SDK, NDK, and AOSP build systems.
+ Knowledge of Android security architecture and best practices.

* Problem\-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with running Android on x86 hardware or on GSIs is a big plus.
* Experience working at third party, open\-source orgs like LineageOS is a big plus.
* Experience working with CTS tests and building CTS\-compliant Android platforms is desired.
* Experience working on Android OS for GMS certified devices is a huge plus.
* Familiarity with Android Enterprise features and device management APIs and/or experience building Android apps and working in the Enterprise space.
